name: Plenoxel
definition: A method that relaxes the PlenOctrees assumption of constant opacity and spherical harmonic coefficients inside each voxel by using trilinear interpolation to define a continuous function throughout the volume.
summary: Plenoxel is a neural-network-free volume rendering method using a sparse 3D voxel grid and trilinear interpolation to achieve faster, continuous scene representation without the computational cost of neural radiance fields.
